topic.title: You're paying for the box
topic.claim: A heavy box makes a ₹500 product feel like ₹2,000, and brands now spend more on the unboxing than on the thing inside.
topic.moment: The magnetic flap, the tissue paper and the card that says 'you deserve this'.

turn.believed: Premium packaging means a premium product.
turn.actually: The box is built for the first thirty seconds, because that's the part that gets filmed and shared.

topic.because: Your unboxing reel is free ads for the brand. The product only has to be fine after that.
topic.payoff: Throw away the box in your head. Would you still pay this for what's left in your hand?
topic.behaviour: D2C brands invest in rigid boxes, inserts and notes; buyers film unboxings and post them.
topic.mechanism: Packaging buys free reach and a feeling of value, which is cheaper than improving the product.
topic.group: Online shoppers who buy D2C brands
topic.send_to: The friend who keeps every nice box 'just in case'.
topic.why_now: Gifting season means the box matters more than ever this month.

score.why: Premium packaging is built for the first thirty seconds that get filmed; the box is the ad.
